title: linaria tenuis var. brachyloba
intro: Linaria tenuis var. brachyloba, commonly known as the Irish eye or buterfly flower, is a plant species within the family Plantaginaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to provide relief from anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation and calming effects, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of sedation and anxiolytic effects. The bioactive constituents present in Linaria tenuis var. brachyloba include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. These properties make the plant a potential remedy for various health conditions, such as insomnia, restlessness, and anxiety disorders, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
